_comment: Catalog items that no task covers and no phase scopes. Kept as an explicit register rather than left to a gate that counted a disclaimer as coverage. `tools/ci/check_phase_scope.py` requires every uncovered-and-unscoped code to appear here, so an item can be deliberately out of scope but never silently absent. Each entry needs a decision; `undecided` is an honest status, not a pass.
_found: 2026-09-05, when check_phase_scope stopped reading Non-goals blocks as coverage claims. Every code below appears in the 117-task plan exactly once or twice, in a Non-goals block, and nowhere else -- so the plan says 'we are not doing this' and nothing says who is.

L1-02.evidence: One mention, inside a Non-goals block, no destination named.

L5-08.evidence: One mention, inside a Non-goals block, marked `horizon` -- the plan's own word for beyond this program. The most likely candidate for a deliberate out-of-scope decision, but it has not been made explicitly.
